title: Trackit
description: A low-overhead Linux system monitor written in C++17. It reads kernel telemetry directly from the /proc filesystem (/proc/stat, /proc/meminfo, and /proc/[pid]/stat) at 500ms intervals, avoiding subprocess spawning overhead. Displays real-time scrolling CPU load, memory utilization, and process status using Dear ImGui and OpenGL 3.3 with a 1.3% CPU footprint.

title: Panopteez
description: An end-to-end distributed observability pipeline. C++ daemon agents gather host system metrics and stream authenticated HTTP payloads to a Node/Express ingestion collector, persisting time-series telemetry into PostgreSQL via Prisma ORM. Orchestrated into a multi-agent cluster using Docker Compose.

title: RedLine
description: An enterprise-grade multimodal multi-agent contract and financial reconciliation engine designed for Google Cloud Consulting. Reconciles complex legal agreements (MSAs, SOWs) and vendor invoices against BigQuery ERP ledgers. Implements Gemini 2.0 Dynamic Adaptive Context Caching (DACC), zero raw SQL parameterized tool boundaries with DLP sanitization, and strictly decouples semantic extraction from deterministic Decimal arithmetic to eliminate math hallucinations.
metrics: Gemini 2.0 DACC • BigQuery ERP • Deterministic Decimal Math

title: Movienator
description: An intelligent, probabilistic 20-questions active learning deduction engine spanning 50,625 Indian cinema records across 19 regional industries. Operates a vectorized Bayesian inference engine using LogSumExp for numerical stability and maximizes Mutual Information (Shannon Entropy) to select optimal discriminating questions. Backed by NumPy compressed attribute matrices and indexed SQLite storage.
metrics: 50,625 Films • 19 Industries • Vectorized LogSumExp Bayesian Engine

title: Perigee
description: An autonomous career discovery platform featuring hybrid search and continuous background feed ingestion. Combines dense 384-dimensional vector embeddings with sparse BM25 keyword matching via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF k=60). Implements zero-downtime atomic index pointer swapping in memory (SearchIndexSnapshot) and incremental SQLite BLOB vector caching, ensuring high query throughput with zero latency spikes.
metrics: Hybrid RRF (Dense + BM25) • Zero-Downtime Atomic Pointer Swapping
